gbx_rst_align_to.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_rst_align_to(tile, reference_tile) AS aligned FROM paired_rasters;
gbx_rst_align_to.description: Warp a tile onto the grid of a reference tile, with nearest-neighbour resampling.

gbx_rst_asformat.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT path, gbx_rst_asformat(tile, 'GTiff') as geotiff_tile FROM netcdf_rasters;
gbx_rst_asformat.description: Re-encode the raster to another GDAL driver (for example PNG, GTiff or COG).

gbx_rst_aspect.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_rst_aspect(tile, false, false) AS aspect FROM dem_rasters;
gbx_rst_aspect.description: Compute the direction of steepest descent from a single-band DEM tile (Horn's 3x3 method).

gbx_rst_avg.examples:

gbx_rst_avg.description: Return the mean of the valid pixels of each band.

gbx_rst_band.examples:

gbx_rst_bandmetadata.examples:

gbx_custom_geomkloopexplode.description: Return the custom-grid cells at exactly k rings from a geometry, one row per cell.

gbx_custom_geomkring.description: Return the custom-grid cells of a geometry dilated by k rings.

gbx_custom_geomkringexplode.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT t.cellid FROM (SELECT 'POLYGON((530200 180200, 534800 180200, 534800 184800, 530200 184800, 530200 180200))' AS geom, gbx_custom_grid(0, 1000000, 0, 1000000, 2, 1000, 1000, 27700) AS grid) src LATERAL VIEW gbx_custom_geomkringexplode(src.geom, src.grid, 0, 1, 'boundary-out') t AS cellid;
gbx_custom_geomkringexplode.description: Return the custom-grid cells of a geometry dilated by k rings, one row per cell.

gbx_custom_grid.usage_args: bound_x_min, bound_x_max, bound_y_min, bound_y_max, cell_splits, root_cell_size_x, root_cell_size_y, [srid]
gbx_custom_grid.description: Define a custom grid and return the grid struct the other `gbx_custom_*` functions take.

gbx_custom_kloop.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_custom_kloop(360287970373976640, gbx_custom_grid(0, 1000000, 0, 1000000, 2, 1000, 1000, 27700), 1) AS kloop;
gbx_custom_kloop.description: Return the custom-grid cells at exactly ring distance k from a cell.

gbx_custom_kring.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_custom_kring(360287970373976640, gbx_custom_grid(0, 1000000, 0, 1000000, 2, 1000, 1000, 27700), 1) AS ring;
gbx_custom_kring.description: Return the custom-grid cells within ring distance k of a cell, the cell included.

gbx_custom_pointascell.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_custom_pointascell('POINT(530000 180000)', gbx_custom_grid(0, 1000000, 0, 1000000, 2, 1000, 1000, 27700), 5) AS cell;
gbx_custom_pointascell.description: Return the custom-grid cell that holds the first coordinate of a geometry.

gbx_custom_polyfill.description: Return the custom-grid cells whose centre lies inside a geometry.

gbx_st_asmvt.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT z, x, y, gbx_st_asmvt(geom_wkb, attrs, 'layer') AS mvt FROM mvt_features GROUP BY z, x, y;

gbx_st_asmvt_pyramid.examples:
Examples:
      > WITH feats AS ( SELECT unhex('010100000000000000000000000000000000000000') AS geom_wkb, named_struct('name', 'origin', 'id', 1L) AS attrs ) SELECT t.z, t.x, t.y, t.mvt_bytes FROM feats, LATERAL gbx_st_asmvt_pyramid(geom_wkb, attrs, 0, 2, 'layer', 4096) t;
gbx_st_asmvt_pyramid.description: Encode one feature into a Mapbox Vector Tile for every web-mercator tile it touches, across a range of zoom levels.

gbx_st_coverageinvalidedges.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT cov_id, gbx_st_coverageinvalidedges(geom, 0.0) AS bad_edges FROM coverage_overlap GROUP BY cov_id;

gbx_st_coverageisvalid.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT cov_id, gbx_st_coverageisvalid(geom, 0.0) AS is_valid FROM coverage_parcels GROUP BY cov_id;

gbx_st_crs.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_st_crs(geom) AS crs FROM vector_geoms;
gbx_st_crs.description: Return the canonical CRS of the SRID a geometry carries.

gbx_st_explainvalidity.description: Diagnose whether a geometry is valid under the OGC Simple Features rules.

gbx_st_interpolateelevationbbox.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT t.elevation_point FROM tin_survey, LATERAL gbx_st_interpolateelevationbbox(pts, bl, 0, 0, 'NONENCROACHING', 0, 0, 10, 10, 3, 3, 0, 'constrained') t;
gbx_st_interpolateelevationbbox.usage_args: points_array, breaklines_array, merge_tolerance, snap_tolerance, split_point_finder, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, width_px, height_px, srid, [mode]
gbx_st_interpolateelevationbbox.description: Interpolate the Z of a triangulated surface at the centres of a bounding-box grid, one row per cell.

gbx_st_interpolateelevationgeom.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT t.elevation_point FROM tin_survey, LATERAL gbx_st_interpolateelevationgeom(pts, bl, 0, 0, 'NONENCROACHING', unhex('010100000000000000000000000000000000002440'), 3, 3, 3, -3, 'constrained') t;
gbx_st_interpolateelevationgeom.usage_args: points_array, breaklines_array, merge_tolerance, snap_tolerance, split_point_finder, grid_origin, grid_cols, grid_rows, cell_size_x, cell_size_y, [mode]
gbx_st_interpolateelevationgeom.description: Interpolate the Z of a triangulated surface at the centres of a grid anchored at a point, one row per cell.

gbx_st_legacyaswkb.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_st_legacyaswkb(geom_legacy) AS wkb FROM legacy_geoms;
gbx_st_legacyaswkb.description: Decode a legacy Mosaic geometry struct to ISO WKB, with Z and holes kept.

gbx_st_makevalid.description: Repair a geometry to OGC-SFS validity.

gbx_st_node.description: Node a linework: split it at every point where its lines cross or touch.

gbx_st_reduceprecision.description: Snap a geometry's coordinates to a grid, keeping the result valid.

gbx_st_removerepeatedpoints.description: Remove consecutive repeated vertices, or near-repeats within a tolerance.

gbx_st_setcrs.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_st_setcrs(geom, 'EPSG:4326') AS stamped FROM vector_geoms;
gbx_st_setcrs.description: Stamp a CRS on a geometry without reprojecting it.

gbx_st_simplifypreservetopology.description: Simplify a geometry with Douglas-Peucker without splitting or collapsing it.

gbx_st_snap.description: Snap a geometry's vertices onto a reference geometry within a tolerance.

gbx_st_split.description: Split a geometry by a blade into the pieces on either side of it.

gbx_st_transformcrs.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_st_transformcrs(geom, 'EPSG:32633') AS utm33n FROM vector_geoms;
gbx_st_transformcrs.description: Reproject a geometry to a target CRS.

gbx_st_triangulate.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT t.triangle FROM tin_survey, LATERAL gbx_st_triangulate(pts, bl, 0, 0, 'NONENCROACHING', 'constrained') t;
gbx_st_triangulate.description: Build a constrained Delaunay triangulation of Z-valued points and break lines, one row per triangle.

gbx_st_wrapx.description: Wrap x coordinates around an origin by a shift.

gbx_pmtiles_agg.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_pmtiles_agg(bytes, z, x, y, '{"name":"my_tileset"}') AS pmt FROM tiles_z2;
gbx_pmtiles_agg.description: Fold the tiles of a group into one PMTiles v3 archive.

gbx_quadbin_aswkb.description: Return the footprint of a quadbin cell as an EWKB polygon in EPSG:4326.

gbx_quadbin_cellfill.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT region, gbx_quadbin_cellfill(cellid, value, 1, 'mean', 2.0) AS filled FROM ( SELECT 1 AS region, gbx_quadbin_pointascell(-0.1, 51.5, 10) AS cellid, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS value UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS region, cell AS cellid, 5.0 AS value FROM ( SELECT explode(gbx_quadbin_kring(gbx_quadbin_pointascell(-0.1, 51.5, 10), 1)) AS cell ) ) t GROUP BY region;

gbx_quadbin_cellunion.description: Return the union of an array of quadbin cells as an EWKB polygon in EPSG:4326.

gbx_quadbin_cellunion_agg.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT region, gbx_quadbin_cellunion_agg(cell) AS coverage FROM ( SELECT 'R1' AS region, explode(gbx_quadbin_kring(gbx_quadbin_pointascell(-122.4194, 37.7749, 10), 1)) AS cell ) t GROUP BY region;

gbx_quadbin_centroid.description: Return the centre of a quadbin cell as an EWKB point in EPSG:4326.

gbx_quadbin_distance.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT gbx_quadbin_distance( gbx_quadbin_pointascell(0.0, 0.0, 10), gbx_quadbin_pointascell(0.0, 0.1, 10) ) AS d;
gbx_quadbin_distance.description: Return the distance in cells between two quadbin cells of the same zoom level.

gbx_quadbin_geomkloop.description: Return the quadbin cells at exactly k rings from a geometry.

gbx_quadbin_geomkloopexplode.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT t.cellid FROM (SELECT 'POLYGON((-73.99 40.71, -73.95 40.71, -73.95 40.75, -73.99 40.75, -73.99 40.71))' AS geom) src LATERAL VIEW gbx_quadbin_geomkloopexplode(src.geom, 12, 1, 'boundary-out') t AS cellid;
gbx_quadbin_geomkloopexplode.description: Return the quadbin cells at exactly k rings from a geometry, one row per cell.

gbx_quadbin_geomkring.description: Return the quadbin cells of a geometry dilated by k rings.

gbx_quadbin_geomkringexplode.examples:
Examples:
      > SELECT t.cellid FROM (SELECT 'POLYGON((-73.99 40.71, -73.95 40.71, -73.95 40.75, -73.99 40.75, -73.99 40.71))' AS geom) src LATERAL VIEW gbx_quadbin_geomkringexplode(src.geom, 12, 1, 'boundary-out') t AS cellid;
gbx_quadbin_geomkringexplode.description: Return the quadbin cells of a geometry dilated by k rings, one row per cell.

gbx_quadbin_kloop.description: Return the quadbin cells at exactly ring distance k from a cell.

gbx_quadbin_kring.description: Return the quadbin cells within ring distance k of a cell, the cell included.

gbx_quadbin_pointascell.description: Return the quadbin cell that holds a longitude and latitude.

gbx_quadbin_polyfill.description: Return the quadbin cells that cover the bounding box of a geometry.

gbx_quadbin_resolution.description: Return the zoom level of a quadbin cell.

gbx_quadbin_tessellate.description: Cut a geometry into quadbin cells, one chip per cell it touches.
